quest.title: Iron Ingot Meets Ziwei
quest.description: Iron Ingot from Liyue Harbor seems to be troubled about something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x100

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: The Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies. It's so beautiful...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you star gazing?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Yes... and no. It's the Lantern Rite, after all. It only seems fitting to look upon such an elegant sight during these festive times.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: I've even been learning how to write poetry, too. The other guys tell me that girls these days are really into that sort of thing.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Hah, I'm sure Ziwei will...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Uh — ahem, well, I've heard a lot of constellation names from Ziwei. *sigh* They all sound so beautiful...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: So you see, I have to thank her somehow!

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: I was thinking that I should write a poem on a Xiao Lantern and find a place to release it together with Ziwei... We'll eat snacks and sing songs...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: If this doesn't get the job done, nothing will!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Get the job... done?

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Ahem, I mean... This will do the job of helping us enjoy the festival more... Yeah, that's it!

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Anyway, I want to find a quiet, scenic spot away from other pedestrians.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: I started asking around and I've found two potential spots so far. Here, have a look.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: The other guys told me that they've released Xiao Lanterns at these spots before...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: But I still need to come up with a poem... and I'm afraid running around to check the spots will just douse my creativity.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Could you help me go check out those two spots?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Sure.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Thanks for your help, I'm counting on you!

talks.objective: Find the first suitable viewing spot and <color=#00E1FFFF>take a picture</color>

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: "Ziwei stumbles across an iron ingot" ...No, no, that won't do. That's laying it on a bit thick...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Oh, when did you get here? Did you check those two spots?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We sure did.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: That didn't take you long. Now let me have a look...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Alright, let me have a look here... Hmm, the surrounding scenery at this spot is very unique, whereas the other spot is centered in a more picturesque landscape. It reminds me of the line, "Ain't no mountain high enough, ain't no..." Uh, I forget what's after that...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Anyway, never mind... Still, these spots look bright and impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: I've got it! I know which one to pick... But, there's still something I'd like to ask of you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: My friends told me that when you go to see someone, it's best to bring something to eat. What do you think I should prepare when I go to see Ziwei?

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Grilled Tiger Fish, hmm... Don't you think that'd be a little too oily? Maybe something a little more light and refined, like Almond Tofu...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Yeah, Almond Tofu! That would be perfect!

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Traveler, could you please help me prepare a serving of Almond Tofu? In the meantime, I'll keep working on my poem here. Now how should this next line go...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: "And countless sparks fly"... Oh, that's a good line!

talks.objective: Find a second suitable viewing spot and <color=#00E1FFFF>take a picture</color>

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Oh, when did you get back? Did you prepare the Almond Tofu?

choices.text: I still need a little more time...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Ah, okay. Don't worry, I can keep working on my poem in the meantime...

talks.objective: Give the Almond Tofu to Iron Ingot

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Well, I guess this will do for now. Let's go find Ziwei!

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Huh? Is it me... Or does this tofu smell funny?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: I could never give this to Ziwei. Maybe you could help get another one?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: This looks great! Everything's ready, all we need to do now is find Ziwei!

talks.objective: Go with Iron Ingot to meet Ziwei

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: From this angle... The constellation looks just like a dog. Now, I must think of a suitable name...

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you, Iron Ingot. What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Umm, well you see... Uh, I—I was just strolling outside the city, and I happened to come across a very scenic spot...

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: A nice spot? You mean for star gazing?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Y—Yes, that's it! A nice spot for star gazing. It'd also be a great place to release Xiao Lanterns... See? I've already prepared one for us.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: And look, I've even written a p—poem on it...

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: "Sparks fly where shovel and meteorite meet."

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: Yes... Well, even though I don't really know what your wish is, the poem is quite interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: But you shouldn't let others see your wish before releasing the Xiao Lantern, otherwise it will never come true.

dialogues.speaker: Ziwei
dialogues.text: And so, what exactly do you need from me?

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Well, I...

choices.text: He found a very suitable spot for releasing a Xiao Lantern.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: Releasing a Xiao Lantern? Oh, I'm sorry... I was actually hoping to go somewhere away from all the lanterns.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: The Xiao Lanterns are so bright that they obstruct my view of the stars. I think I'll be going as far as I can away from the festivities.

response.speaker: Ziwei
response.text: Thanks for the kind offer, but I should get going. Happy Lantern Rite.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: O—Oh...

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: I... I'm fine. Clearly, I must have made my poem too abstract. Ziwei didn't get it at all.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Don't worry, I won't let it get to me. She'll finally understand my meaning one day.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Thanks for your help anyway, Traveler. Here, these are for you.

response.speaker: Iron Ingot
response.text: Oh, I guess I should at least release this Xiao Lantern now...

choices.text: So if you'd like to release a lantern tonight, you can go together with him.

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Alright, we've checked both spots. Let's go back and find Iron Ingot. Wonder how his poem is coming along...

dialogues.speaker: Iron Ingot
dialogues.text: Mysterious Adeptus of the Highest Heaven Soaring Across the Skies... What does it mean?
